description: This file contains unit tests for decoding different types of GatewayFrame objects from JSON data, including event frames, request frames with nested parameters, and unknown frames. It verifies correct decoding and payload handling within the GatewayFrame structure.

methods.name: `decodes event frame with any codable payload`
methods.description: Tests decoding of an event frame with a payload containing generic codable data.

methods.name: `decodes request frame with nested params`
methods.description: Tests decoding of a request frame with nested parameters, including arrays and nested dictionaries.

methods.name: `decodes unknown frame and preserves raw`
methods.description: Tests the decoding of an unrecognized frame type, ensuring raw data is preserved.
